name: dj-librarian
description: The engine of dj-librarian: reads your rekordbox library and Spotify inboxes, proposes crates, playlist trees and tag fixes. Create and add only, dry-run first, nothing written without your yes.
long_description: The part of dj-librarian that talks to rekordbox and Spotify. It reads your library, matches Spotify inboxes against your crates, builds playlist trees and tidies empty tags. rekordbox stays the source of truth: every write tool has a preview first and runs only after you say yes, and it only ever adds. Point it at your dj-library folder; your Spotify keys stay in this extension's settings.

library_folder.title: dj-library folder
library_folder.description: Your dj-library folder: where your rekordbox export, links.yaml, tidy.yaml, plans and reports live. Pick the folder, not a file in it.

spotify_client_id.title: Spotify client ID
spotify_client_id.description: The Client ID of your own Spotify app (developer.spotify.com, Dashboard). Only needed to pull Spotify inboxes or push playlists. Leave empty to skip Spotify.

spotify_client_secret.title: Spotify client secret
spotify_client_secret.description: The Client secret of the same Spotify app. Kept in this extension's settings, never in a file.

power_mode.title: Power mode (Windows)
power_mode.description: Off: changes reach rekordbox only as an XML file you import. On: write tools may also write straight into rekordbox's database on Windows, with rekordbox closed and a backup first. Leave it off unless you know you want it.

tools.name: dj_status
tools.description: Library overview: counts, whether rekordbox is running, the playlist tree and each Spotify link's state.

tools.name: dj_tree_preview
tools.description: Dry-run of a tree file (e.g. bases.yaml): one action per node and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_library_inspect
tools.description: Library summary: counts, a sample of the playlist tree, which fields the source lacks.

tools.name: dj_library_analyze
tools.description: Analyse the library in one go: profile, identity, structure proposals, taste, and the HTML report.

tools.name: dj_backup
tools.description: A verified copy of your rekordbox database in your dj-library folder, with restore steps. Never writes rekordbox.

tools.name: dj_pull
tools.description: Download a Spotify inbox playlist into the inbox. Read-only on Spotify and rekordbox.

tools.name: dj_match
tools.description: Match the last pull of a link against the library: in crate, propose, ambiguous, missing, declined.

tools.name: dj_plan
tools.description: Write a plan and a wishlist for a crate (text files in the dj-library folder; rekordbox untouched).

tools.name: dj_wishlist_shop
tools.description: Write the shopping list of a crate's missing tracks with Beatport and Bandcamp search links.

tools.name: dj_apply_preview
tools.description: Dry-run of a plan: which yes tracks would be added to the crate, and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_copy_preview
tools.description: Dry-run: which tracks of one playlist would be appended to another, and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_build_preview
tools.description: Dry-run: match the lines of a tracklist file on Spotify, and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_push_preview
tools.description: Dry-run: match a rekordbox playlist on Spotify, and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_tree_apply
tools.description: WRITES to rekordbox master.db: create the missing folders and playlists of a tree file.

tools.name: dj_apply_write
tools.description: WRITES the yes tracks of a plan for its crate, as an XML to import or in power mode.

tools.name: dj_copy_apply
tools.description: WRITES the tracks one playlist has and the other lacks, as an XML to import or in power mode.

tools.name: dj_build_apply
tools.description: WRITES to Spotify: create a private playlist from a tracklist file and add the matched tracks.

tools.name: dj_push_apply
tools.description: WRITES to Spotify: create a private playlist for a rekordbox playlist and add the matched tracks.

tools.name: dj_structure_preview
tools.description: Preview a structure proposal against the current tree, and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_structure_write
tools.description: WRITES a rekordbox XML of the chosen structure for you to import, and records the choice.

tools.name: dj_crate_preview
tools.description: Preview a crate picked from your own library, with a reason per pick, and a preview_id.

tools.name: dj_crate_write
tools.description: WRITES a rekordbox XML of the crate for you to import, and the crate record.

tools.name: dj_tidy_audit
tools.description: Hygiene audit of the audio files behind a crate, a folder or the collection: tags, artwork, names, playability.

tools.name: dj_tidy_dupes
tools.description: Read-only duplicate report with a suggested keeper per group. Never deletes or moves.

tools.name: dj_tidy_plan
tools.description: Write a tidy plan: values for empty tags parsed from file names, plus local cover art.

tools.name: dj_tidy_apply_preview
tools.description: Dry-run of a tidy plan: which items would be written and which cannot run, and a preview_id.

tools.name: dj_tidy_apply
tools.description: WRITES AUDIO FILES: the yes tag changes and planned renames of a tidy plan, undo record first.

tools.name: dj_tidy_undo_preview
tools.description: Dry-run of undoing a tidy plan's apply, and a preview_id. Writes nothing.

tools.name: dj_tidy_undo
tools.description: WRITES AUDIO FILES: restores the tags and names a tidy plan's apply changed.

tools.name: dj_barber_next
tools.description: Style Barber: plan or resume today's short taste session and return the next question.

tools.name: dj_barber_record
tools.description: Record your answer to a Style Barber question as one dated line in your taste files.
